comments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep lifecycle payload compatible with llm_request_event signature**

`call_llm()` now always injects `model_id_requested` and `_resolved_from_alias` into every lifecycle event payload, but the main callback wiring in `run_extraction_v5` still does `ui.llm_request_event(**payload)` and `llm_request_event` has no parameters for these new keys (it also lacks `cache_write_tokens`/`service_tier_requested` for the completed event). In any path where `lifecycle_callback` is enabled, the first `_emit_lifecycle("started", ...)` call raises `TypeError` before the provider request runs, breaking normal extraction execution with UI events enabled.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: The lifecycle callback payload now includes `model_id_requested` and `_resolved_from_alias` as top-level keys. In `run_extraction_v5`, the callback is `lambda payload: ui.llm_request_event(**payload)`, and `UI.llm_request_event` does not accept these kwargs today, so this will raise `TypeError` on every started/completed/failed emission. To preserve compatibility, keep lifecycle payload keys constrained to the existing `llm_request_event` parameter set and place additional fields under the existing `extra` dict (or otherwise version/gate the callback contract).

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: `_emit_lifecycle(..., cache_write_tokens=..., service_tier_requested=...)` will also break the existing `UI.llm_request_event(**payload)` consumer because `llm_request_event` doesn't accept `cache_write_tokens` or `service_tier_requested` kwargs. Consider moving these (and any other new telemetry fields) into the `extra` payload so UI/events remain backwards compatible, or update the lifecycle consumer contract in the same PR.

comments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Drop unknown lifecycle kwarg before dispatching completed event**

The new `cache_strategy_applied` field is passed in `_emit_lifecycle("completed", ...)`, but `run_extraction_v5` dispatches lifecycle payloads via `ui.llm_request_event(**payload)` and `llm_request_event` does not accept a `cache_strategy_applied` parameter. In any successful LLM call path with lifecycle events enabled, this raises `TypeError` during the completed callback and can abort extraction after the provider call returns. This is a separate compatibility break from the other new lifecycle keys and needs to be filtered or explicitly supported.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
